heading.en: Birth, early career and party founding

body.zh-Hant: 普呂姆1886年7月9日生於特魯瓦維耶爾，父親是克萊沃的右派政治人物埃米爾·普呂姆。他是律師，並曾任克萊沃縣議員。1918年5月16日他離開右派黨，創立獨立民族黨。
body.en: Pierre Prüm was born on 9 July 1886 in Troisvierges, son of the right-wing politician Émile Prüm of Clervaux. He was a lawyer and a deputy for the canton of Clervaux. On 16 May 1918 he left the Party of the Right and founded the Independent National Party.

heading.en: Minister of State and head of government

body.zh-Hant: 1925年3月19日起，普呂姆任國務大臣、政府首腦，並兼外交、內政與農業總局長。他依靠自由派、社會黨人與右派叛離者組成的雜牌聯盟；1925年10月9日與阿爾薩斯－洛林鐵路管理局達成臨時協議。因失去多數，政府於1926年7月15日辭職。
body.en: From 19 March 1925 Prüm was Minister of State and president of the government, also holding the directorates-general of Foreign Affairs, Interior and Agriculture. He relied on a motley alliance of liberals, socialists and defectors from the right; on 9 October 1925 a modus vivendi was concluded with the Alsace-Lorraine railway administration. With no majority left, his government resigned on 15 July 1926.

heading.en: Justice of the peace, occupation years and death

body.zh-Hant: 1926年至1936年，普呂姆任克萊沃的治安法官。1937年他當選北區議員；1940至1944年為Gedelit成員。1946年11月28日他因通敵被判四年徒刑，1950年死於克萊沃。
body.en: From 1926 to 1936 Prüm was justice of the peace in Clervaux. In 1937 he was elected deputy for the North constituency; from 1940 to 1944 he was a member of the Gedelit. On 28 November 1946 he was sentenced to four years in prison for collaboration, and he died in Clervaux in 1950.

heading.en: Elected prince; Romania raised to a kingdom

body.zh-Hant: 1866年4月20日，卡羅爾在公民投票中當選羅馬尼亞親王，繼承被軍官陰謀推翻的前任。1881年3月26日國會決議將公國升格為王國，他於同年5月25日加冕為國王。德國的NDB條目稱他在位48年。
body.en: On 20 April 1866 Carol was elected Prince of Romania in a plebiscite, succeeding a ruler overthrown by an officers' conspiracy. By a parliamentary resolution of 26 March 1881 the principality became a kingdom, and he was crowned king on 25 May 1881. The NDB speaks of his 48-year reign.

heading.zh-Hant: 晚期：1907年起義、巴爾幹戰爭與1914年御前會議
heading.en: Late reign: 1907 revolt, Balkan war, 1914 crown council

body.zh-Hant: 1907年摩爾達維亞爆發血腥農民起義。第二次巴爾幹戰爭中，他藉1913年8月10日的布加勒斯特和約自保加利亞取得南多布羅加。1914年8月3日，他在佩雷什堡御前會議上主張與同盟國並肩參戰，只有卡爾普支持，其餘十七名與會者反對；他僅能爭得宣布嚴守中立。數週後他以75歲辭世。
body.en: In 1907 a bloody peasant uprising broke out in Moldavia. In the Second Balkan War he gained southern Dobruja from Bulgaria in the Peace of Bucharest of 10 August 1913. At the crown council at Peles Castle on 3 August 1914 he argued for entering the war alongside the Central Powers; supported only by P. Carp, he stood alone against the other seventeen participants, and could only secure a proclamation of strict neutrality. A few weeks later he died aged 75.

body.zh-Hant: 哈查1872年7月12日生於特爾霍韋斯維尼，是法律人。1898年他進入捷克邦自治行政機構任職。
body.en: Hácha was born on 12 July 1872 in Trhové Sviny and was a lawyer. In 1898 he entered the service of the Czech provincial self-government.

citations.quote: * 12. 7. 1872 Trhové Sviny, † 27. 6. 1945 Praha, právník
1898 vstoupil do služeb české zemské samosprávy

body.zh-Hant: 1916至1918年他任維也納最高行政法院的法官（rada）。捷克斯洛伐克成立後，他於1925年出任最高行政法院第一院長，並在1924年被選為海牙常設仲裁法院法官；1938年11月底他離開最高行政法院。
body.en: In 1916–18 he served as a councillor of the Supreme Administrative Court in Vienna. In independent Czechoslovakia he became first president of the Supreme Administrative Court in 1925; he had been elected a judge of the Permanent Court of Arbitration at The Hague in 1924. At the end of November 1938 he left the Supreme Administrative Court.

heading.zh-Hant: 當選總統與保護國宣告
heading.en: Election as president and the Protectorate

body.zh-Hant: 1938年11月30日，哈查在兩院聯席會議上以312票中的272票當選為第三任捷克斯洛伐克總統，任期三個半月。1939年3月14日他赴柏林與希特勒會談，希特勒告知德國將占領捷克地區，並在15日夜間強迫他簽署文件。翌日希特勒在布拉格宣布成立波希米亞與摩拉維亞保護國，由哈查任「國家總統」。
body.en: On 30 November 1938 Hácha was elected third Czechoslovak president by a joint session of both chambers, with 272 of 312 votes; he held the office for three and a half months. On 14 March 1939 he travelled to Berlin, where Hitler announced the German occupation and, during the night of 15 March, forced him by brutal pressure to sign a document. The next day Hitler proclaimed the Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia in Prague, with Hácha as "state president".

body.zh-Hant: 1945年5月13日哈查被捕，送往布拉格潘克拉茨監獄醫院，6月27日在該處去世。
body.en: Hácha was arrested on 13 May 1945 and taken to the Pankrác prison hospital in Prague, where he died on 27 June 1945.

people.nameZh: 埃米利亞諾·查莫羅·巴爾加斯

heading.en: Birth and the overthrow of Zelaya

body.zh-Hant: 查莫羅1871年5月11日出生。他1903年起從軍，指揮反抗自由黨獨裁者薩拉亞的起義；到1909年，薩拉亞在保守派與反薩拉亞自由派的壓力下下台。
body.en: Chamorro was born on 11 May 1871. He began his military career in 1903, commanding an uprising against the Liberal dictator José Santos Zelaya; by 1909 Zelaya had resigned under pressure.

citations.quote: b. 11 May 1871; d. 26 February 1966)

heading.zh-Hant: 保守黨領袖、駐美公使與布萊恩－查莫羅條約
heading.en: Conservative leader, envoy and the Bryan–Chamorro Treaty

body.zh-Hant: 薩拉亞下台後，查莫羅鞏固了保守黨領袖地位，並任制憲議會議長。1912年他再度出兵，擊敗反叛迪亞斯總統的戰爭部長路易斯·梅納。美國屬意迪亞斯，遂提供他駐美公使一職；他以公使身分談判並簽署《布萊恩－查莫羅條約》。1916年他辭去公使職務，並在美國支持下贏得1916年大選。
body.en: After Zelaya's fall Chamorro solidified his position as leader of the Conservative Party and headed the Constituent Assembly. In 1912 he returned to the battlefield against War Minister Luis Mena, who had revolted against President Adolfo Díaz. The U.S. offered him the post of envoy to the U.S.; as envoy he negotiated and signed the Bryan–Chamorro Treaty. He resigned as envoy in 1916 and won the 1916 election with U.S. support.
